partial_progress.details: 32-phase plan written. Route recommendation: cut-free nested sequents (Arisaka-Das-Strassburger) as primary; product-model-over-IS5 route closed because its residual R-b is equivalent to the CS5=IS5 collapse. Two-label bridge planned explicitly as a separate stage and flagged as the larger risk.

memory_candidates.content: Formalising a cut-free sequent/nested-sequent system in Lean decomposes into a stable 12-step chain, each step one agent run: (1) syntax as separate mutual inductives per polarity so well-formedness invariants hold by construction rather than as predicates; (2) contexts encoded in their structural normal form (e.g. a List of layers) so context well-formedness is definitional and the paper's 'every context has shape X' observation needs no proof; (3) compositionality lemmas for the corresponding-formula translation over contexts; (4) rule inductive plus a height measure; (5) axiom-set extension rules; (6) soundness auxiliaries; (7) soundness; (8) completeness with cut; (9) super-rules and their mutual derivability; (10) height-preserving admissibility of structural rules; (11) a well-founded cut-value measure; (12) principal cases one lemma per connective, then commutative cases, then assembly. CSLib's Cslib/Logics/Propositional/SequentCalculus/LJ/CutElimination.lean is a proven in-repo template of exactly this shape (711 lines, sorry-free), and SubformulaProperty.lean the follow-on. Stage boundaries after 'cut-free completeness' and 'subformula property' are natural task-split points and give real partial payoff even when a later extension stage is blocked.
